app.title: MC Content Localizer
app.clickSelectMod: Click to select or drop mod jar
app.clickSelectShader: Click to select or drop shader pack
app.clickSelectResource: Click to select or drop resource pack
app.modDesc: Supports multi-select, Forge / Fabric / NeoForge, auto-detect language files and hardcoded text
app.shaderDesc: Supports .zip shader packs (Complementary, BSL, etc.), auto-parses UI text and embedded Chinese
app.resourceDesc: Supports .zip resource packs, auto-parses pack.mcmeta description
app.tipSettings: Or configure AI translation service in Settings first
app.deepScanDesc: If text parsing is insufficient, click to perform deep scan on the mod (scans all text files; compiled .class text not supported yet).
app.deepScanText: Deep scan text in mod (unchecked by default, included in translation/export after checking):
app.termModalDesc: These terms were automatically extracted and used for this translation. Check to **add to user glossary** (global effect for future translations); unchecked for one-time use only:
app.riskDesc: This mod contains deep-scanned embedded text (non-language files, directly in json/config files). Modifying these fields may affect mod behavior.
app.riskCheckedDesc: {count} mods' deep-scanned text included in export. Choose handling:
app.skipDeep: Skip deep scan text, export language files only (recommended)
app.includeDeep: Include deep scan text (may have risk)
app.noTranslations: Nothing to export: no "translated" entry is selected. Please confirm: ① the entries to export are checked; ② their translation status is not red (failed).
app.riskOk: Skip deep scan text, export language files only (recommended)
app.riskWarn: Include deep scan text (may have risk)
app.chooseDir: Select directory (generate {count} translated jars, no overwrite)
app.chooseDirPack: Select export directory (generate mods_zh_cn.zip merged resource pack)
app.chooseDirShader: Select export directory (generate translated shader pack)
app.jarExport: Select directory (will generate translated jar, no overwrite)
app.suggestDesc: These terms appear ≥3 times, recommended to add to user glossary for consistent naming. Check to "Add to Glossary" will take effect in next translation.
app.glossaryModalDesc: Select which prompt segment to edit (editable segments are open, core segments are system-preserved):
app.packSettingsDesc: Single pack settings: resource pack format, merged name, export path, whether to export jar
app.packNameDesc: Generated resource pack name prefix, e.g. "Mods_Zh_CN", resulting in {name}.zip
app.exportJarDesc: Whether to generate an independent translated jar for this mod (preserves original file, writes translated content to zh_cn.json or hardcoded locations).
app.exportPathDesc: Export jar or shader pack to specified directory (generates new file with timestamp if not overwriting).
app.exportJarPathDesc: Export translated jar to specified directory (generates new file if not overwriting).
app.alertEmpty: {empty} entries returned no translation. Suggestions: ① reduce "Batch Size" in Settings and re-translate these entries; ② switch to a more stable model.
app.alertError429: {error} entries failed due to API rate limiting (429). Suggestions: increase "Request Interval" or lower "Thread Count" in Settings, or retry later.
app.alertErrorOther: {error} entries failed (marked red). Mostly network errors or invalid key/model config. Check your API Key and model name in "Settings" and retry.
app.alertWarn: {warn} entries have placeholder/format validation warnings (orange tags). Verify %s, § codes are intact before export to avoid in-game display issues.
app.alertInfo: No new translations in this batch.
app.msgApiKeyRequired: An API Key is required to translate. Click "Settings" (top-right) → "Provider & Model", enter your API Key and translate again.
app.msgParseCorrupt: "{name}" read failed: the file may be corrupted, locked by another program, or not a valid archive. Re-download it or close programs using it, then retry.
app.msgParseNotPack: "{name}" is not recognized as translatable content: it is neither a standard mod nor a resource/shader pack, or contains no translatable text. Verify the file source, or try "Deep Scan" on the mod.
app.msgNoExportItem: "{name}" has no translatable entries to export: no "checked and translated" entries under this mod, skipped.
app.msgSettingsLoadFailed: Failed to load settings, using defaults. You can adjust them in "Settings".

provider.groupDesc: Each provider keeps its own API key and model choice — switching providers never mixes configs
provider.label: Provider
provider.modelExtraZhipu: Free model; you can also fetch the list to pick others
provider.modelExtra: Click "Fetch models" to load the list, or type a name manually
provider.modelPlaceholderCustom: Pick or type a model name
provider.modelPlaceholderNeedKey: Enter your API key, then click "Fetch models"
provider.hintDoubao: Doubao: use a model ID, or an endpoint ID created in the Volcano Ark console (ep- prefix)
provider.hintMoonshot: Kimi: models iterate fast — click "Fetch models" to see what's available
provider.hintOpenai: OpenAI: access from mainland China can be unstable; a proxy may be needed
provider.hintOpenrouter: OpenRouter: one key for every platform; model IDs carry vendor prefixes (e.g. google/gemini-2.5-flash)
provider.hintCustom: Custom: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Base URL + model name)

params.groupDesc: Lower temperature gives steadier output; batch size affects request size and streaming granularity
params.batchSizeAutoTooltip: When on, batch size = entries to translate / threads (rounded up) for full-thread throughput. Note: with few entries or many similar items in one batch (e.g. lots of alike config keys), the model may return the source text unchanged ("translation identical to source"); if that happens you'll be asked whether to clear and re-translate
params.batchSizeTooltip: Entries per request (1-200); translations are streamed batch by batch

glossary.groupDesc: Unify terms and style: the glossary locks proper-noun translations, prompts define the translator role and rules
glossary.extractTooltip: Before translating, let the AI extract a glossary of proper nouns from the entries to unify translations
glossary.customDesc: Custom glossary (unify terms, e.g. Diamond → 钻石; format: English → Chinese)
glossary.empty: No custom terms yet — add one with the button below

threading.warn: Parallel requests are more likely to hit provider rate limits (429); the app backs off and retries automatically. Pick threads and intervals based on your provider's limits — longer intervals are safer.
threading.intervalTooltip: Gap between requests within each thread — longer gaps are less likely to trigger rate limits
threading.deepScanTooltip: Parses embedded text that a normal scan may miss (config files, advancements, manuals, nested jars, etc.). Compiled .class code text is not supported yet.
threading.deepScanDesc: When on, mods whose normal parse is empty automatically get a deep scan; you can also click "Deep scan" on a mod card
threading.packWarn: Translating several packs at once multiplies concurrency and makes rate limiting much more likely; all packs also share the per-thread request quota. Choose the pack count based on your provider's limits.

appearance.groupDesc: Theme and language are independent — any combination; changes apply immediately after saving
appearance.closeBehaviorTip: "Minimize to tray": the close button only hides the window — restore or exit from the tray icon; your pack list and progress are kept

about.title: MC Content Localizer
about.desc: AI localization desktop tool for Minecraft mods / shader packs / resource packs
about.author: By adssadax-1 · Fully open source and free (MIT)

msg.fetchEmpty: No models returned — type a model name manually
msg.providerMissing: Provider config missing — check the "Provider & Model" section
msg.updateContent: Current v{cur}, latest v{latest}. Open GitHub to download?
msg.updateCheckFailed: Can't reach GitHub to check for updates

components.checkHint: Checked = included in translation (unchecked are skipped)

eventStream.noData: Waiting for events… Trigger a translation or drop a file and all Tauri events will appear here in real time.

invokeLog.noData: Waiting for invokes… Every command call will be logged here.

requestResponse.noPairs: No request/response pairs yet. HTTP request payloads are captured automatically during translation.

retryChain.noData: No retry records yet. Retries and degradation chains will appear here when translation hits 429/400 errors.

threadSchedule.noData: No schedule records yet. Each worker's batch sequence and throttle will appear here during multi-threaded translation.
threadSchedule.desc: Each box = one content pack; each row inside = one worker thread of that pack. Block width ≈ batch duration; numbers on the right = batches done / total.

injection.errorPopupHint: Buttons raise the app's real result alert on the main window (same render path as the post-translation Alert). Switch to the main window to see it.

parserTestbed.pasteHere: Paste language file content here, auto-parsed (no disk write)…
parserTestbed.noResult: Parsed key-value pairs will appear here after pasting text.

exportPreview.noEntries: No translated entries available to preview export content.

promptEditor.title: Custom Prompts
promptEditor.warning: Custom content can affect translation quality. The "editable section" below is free to modify; the "reserved section" at the bottom must not be changed (removing it breaks output parsing or corrupts placeholders).
promptEditor.editable: Editable section (role / context rules / reference terms)
promptEditor.reserved: Reserved section (read-only, appended automatically when translating)
promptEditor.reservedTip: System reserved: deleting it breaks output parsing or corrupts placeholders
